name: Unending Torment

angles.text: As a Forsaken, you know the living may call you an abomination. Helping Master Apothecary Faranell supports the Royal Apothecary Society's grim work.
As a Horde champion in Lordaeron, you see the ruthlessness of your Forsaken allies. Faranell's delight in breaking stubborn captives reveals the dark pragmatism of the Undercity.

faq.answer: Unending Torment sends you to face a defiant subject tied to the Royal Apothecary Society. The prisoner or hostile being calls you an abomination and refuses to help, so you report this failure to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
A defiant subject rejects your approach and calls you an abomination. The captive remains nameless in the exchange and sends you back to the Royal Apothecary Society's leadership with your findings.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Unending Torment?

faq.answer: Master Apothecary Faranell leads the Royal Apothecary Society in the Apothecarium, beneath the ruins of Lordaeron in the Undercity. He oversees Forsaken alchemists and researchers who develop plagues, concoctions, and poisons to defend the Forsaken and destroy their enemies across Azeroth.
The captive calls you an abomination out of disgust for the undead and their agents. Many living beings and enemies of the Forsaken share this horror of the animated dead in the Undercity.
faq.q: Why does the speaker call the player an abomination?

aliases: where to turn in unending torment
who to report to unending torment
faq.answer: Report the subject's refusal directly to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity. Deep in the Apothecarium, fellow researchers surround him as they make lethal concoctions for Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and the Forsaken.
faq.q: Where must you report after completing the task?

faq.answer: Master Apothecary Faranell is pleased by the subject's stubborn refusal. He welcomes the impasse as an entertaining challenge and relishes testing difficult subjects with the Royal Apothecary Society's ruthless methods.
faq.q: How does Master Apothecary Faranell react to the subject's defiance?

sections.body: A subject under the Royal Apothecary Society's scrutiny despises you. The captive calls you an abomination and refuses to help. Such hatred is familiar to the Forsaken, for many living beings and captives recoil from Lordaeron's undead.
sections.title: Defiance in the Shadows

sections.body: You bring the subject's refusal to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity. The head of the Royal Apothecary Society greets the news with wicked delight. To him, resistance makes the subject a challenge, fit for the cruel experiments of the Apothecarium.
sections.title: Faranell's Ambition

summary: At the Undercity, a defiant subject refuses the Royal Apothecary Society's demands. Master Apothecary Faranell welcomes the news, eager to break a difficult captive.
